text_markup: The Runner approaches a server protected by 3 advanced pieces of ice and with a rezzed {card:Cayambe Grid} in its root. They pay the nested cost in {card:Cayambe Grid}'s ability. This cost is 1 payment of 6[c], not 3 payments of 2[c], so this only meets the trigger condition for 1 instance of {card:GameNET}'s ability.
